The four shot pages are a day page, two session detail pages and an ai2 card. None is the Sessions grid. So I could not confirm the grid, the scope breadcrumb or the left rail from these shots. Fixing that means re-shooting `/framework/ai/sessions/` and `/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/` and reviewing again.

The same CSS change hides the second `.sessions-counts` (the OpenRouter dollars) with `display: none`, which I logged as a note.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/sessions-page-layout/review/report.md`. I made no code edits.
